rows.b: Nubeqa (royalties and product sales to Bayer)
rows.v_note: FY2025 (year ended 31 December 2025) Nubeqa revenue EUR 609.8m: royalties EUR 432.5m and product sales EUR 177.3m; excludes milestones. Converted at the 2025 annual-average rate USD 1.1300 per EUR (Bundesbank/ECB: https://publikationen.bundesbank.de/caas/v1/media/991180/data/6619b8e9182777187f1050fb32ce26c9).
rows.v_note_zh: FY2025（截至2025年12月31日的年度）Nubeqa收入EUR 609.8m：特许权使用费EUR 432.5m和产品销售额EUR 177.3m；不含里程碑付款。按2025年年度平均汇率USD 1.1300/EUR折算（Bundesbank/ECB：https://publikationen.bundesbank.de/caas/v1/media/991180/data/6619b8e9182777187f1050fb32ce26c9）。

loe.note: Bayer 2025 Annual Report, printed p. 52: Nubeqa active-ingredient patent expiration. This is the partner company patent milestone, not a confirmed generic launch; later formulation/crystalline-form patents may expire later.
loe.note_zh: Bayer 2025年年报印刷页第52页:Nubeqa活性成分专利到期。这是合作公司的专利里程碑,并非已确认的仿制药上市;后续制剂/晶型专利可能更晚到期。
